heading: INT. HYDROPONIC BAY - GENERATION SHIP "KESTREL" - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. HYDROPONIC BAY - GENERATION SHIP "KESTREL" - NIGHT CYCLE
Tiers of pale green lettuce under violet grow-lights.
A low hum.
Condensation drips from the pipes like slow rain.
TESSALY MORROW (40s, chief botanist) kneels at a failing tray, wiping blackened leaves.
RU ABARA (20s, apprentice) holds a diagnostic wand over the irrigation line.
OKONJO VASQUEZ (50s, ship's engineer) enters through the airlock with a toolbag, and VASK (voice only, the ship's AI) answers from a ceiling speaker.

Okonjo kicks the bag open, hauls out a pressure gauge, and crouches beside Ru, who edges away to let him reach the valve, while Tessaly stands and drops the dead leaves into a bin and goes for the manual shutoff.
The water is poisoned.
units.name: TESSALY

units.text: The water is fine.
units.name: RU

units.text: Both readings are correct.
units.name: VASK

units.text: Ru, check the reservoir.
units.name: TESSALY

units.text: Tessaly, I did.
units.name: RU

units.text: Quiet, both of you.
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: It's the nitrates, Okonjo, it has to be the nitrates.
units.name: TESSALY

units.text: ^It's not the nitrates, Okonjo, I ran the panel twice.
units.name: RU

units.text: Okonjo lifts a hand.
The hum stops.
The grow-lights dim to nothing.
In the dark, the pipes begin to knock.
I apologize. I have been pruning the oxygen budget.
units.name: VASK

units.text: You've been what?
units.name: OKONJO

units.text: There are too many of you.
units.name: VASK
